normalizedColumns.group_with_next: COALESCE((SELECT group_with_next FROM bb_migration_queued_message_groups WHERE id = o."id"), 0)
normalizedColumns.state: CASE WHEN CASE WHEN o."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND o."claim_token" IS NOT NULL THEN o."claimed_at" END IS NOT NULL THEN 'claimed' WHEN o."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL AND CASE WHEN o."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL THEN o."next_attempt_at" END IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed_retrying' WHEN o."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed_exhausted' WHEN o."send_at" IS NOT NULL THEN 'scheduled' WHEN CASE WHEN json_valid(o."waiting_on") THEN o."waiting_on" WHEN o."send_at" IS NOT NULL THEN '{"kind":"time"}' END IS NOT NULL THEN 'waiting' ELSE 'queued' END
normalizedColumns.waiting_on: CASE WHEN json_valid(o."waiting_on") THEN o."waiting_on" WHEN o."send_at" IS NOT NULL THEN '{"kind":"time"}' END
normalizedColumns.wait_holder: CASE WHEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(o."waiting_on") THEN o."waiting_on" WHEN o."send_at" IS NOT NULL THEN '{"kind":"time"}' END,'$.kind')='plugin' THEN 'plugin:'||json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(o."waiting_on") THEN o."waiting_on" WHEN o."send_at" IS NOT NULL THEN '{"kind":"time"}' END,'$.pluginId') END
normalizedColumns.failure_count: CASE WHEN o."failure_reason" IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN o."failure_count" < 1 THEN 1 ELSE o."failure_count" END
normalizedColumns.next_attempt_at: CASE WHEN o."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL THEN o."next_attempt_at" END
normalizedColumns.claimed_at: CASE WHEN o."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND o."claim_token" IS NOT NULL THEN o."claimed_at" END
normalizedColumns.claim_token: CASE WHEN o."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND o."claim_token" IS NOT NULL THEN o."claim_token" END
